title: aubregrinia taiensis
intro: Aubregrinia taiensis, commonly known as  Taiwanese angelica tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Taiwan, to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aubregrinia taiensis include relieving pain, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Aubregrinia taiensis also exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities, further highlighting its medicinal value.
